pool.name: Pro Database
pool.tagline: Thousands of pros, from superstars to squad fillers.
pool.description: A deep ratings database: the EA SPORTS FC 26 men's player ratings for today's pros, plus players from FIFA 15-23 who have since left the game at their best rating in that data. Rated 70 and up, so later phases have a long tail of cheaper players.

credit.author: EA SPORTS FC 26 ratings (ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/ratings) and sofifa.com via the FIFA 15-23 player dataset
